items.title: Build a single-page specimen sheet of every way to style a UI element
items.summary: A single HTML file with a default-rendering baseline followed by labelled styled variations of the chosen element, each with its CSS shown beneath it. It is laid out so screenshots from different browsers can be compared side by side. A short list of the variations follows the code.

items.title: Define success criteria and test cases before improving a prompt
items.summary: A list of checkable success criteria, a set of test inputs with expected pass conditions, a blank scoring table, and a short note on which problems prompt changes can and cannot fix.

items.title: Rewrite a draft prompt to be clearer, with examples and XML structure
items.summary: A short list of problems found in the draft, followed by a rewritten prompt split into tagged sections with example inputs and outputs, and a brief explanation of the changes.

items.title: Build a new plugin by pointing an AI coding agent at reference code
items.summary: A new project scaffold that mirrors the reference projects' structure, with a list of created files, a report of which tests ran, a list of unverified parts, and a short README section.
